description: This file defines the PHP class WellArchitectedClient, which is a client for interacting with the AWS Well-Architected Tool service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, and updating review templates, workloads, and lenses.

classes.name: WellArchitectedClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Well-Architected Tool, extending the AwsClient base class, providing methods for interacting with the service.

methods.name: associateLenses
methods.description: Associates lenses with a resource in AWS Well-Architected Tool.

methods.name: associateProfiles
methods.description: Associates profiles within the AWS Well-Architected framework.
